name: Account Opening Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of account to which an account opening request is related, eg, a new account.

NEWA.name: New Account Opening
NEWA.definition: Account request is to open a new account.

SUPA.name: Supplementary Account Opening
SUPA.definition: Account request is to open a supplementary account, that is, based on an existing account.
